spec.query:
sum(
  max by (compute_host, resource) (
    cortex_vmware_host_capacity_usage{
      resource="cpu",
      availability_zone=~"$availability_zone",
      compute_host=~"$compute_host",
      # Remove enabled from decommissioned workload, since usually decommissioned hypervisors are disabled
      workload_type="general-purpose",
      decommissioned="true",
      external_customer="false",
      pinned_projects="false"
    }
  )
) or vector(0)

sum(
  max by (compute_host, resource) (
    cortex_vmware_host_capacity_usage{
      resource="cpu",
      availability_zone=~"$availability_zone",
      compute_host=~"$compute_host",
      # Remove enabled from decommissioned workload, since usually decommissioned hypervisors are disabled
      workload_type="hana",
      cpu_architecture="sapphire-rapids",
      decommissioned="true",
      external_customer="false",
      pinned_projects="false"
    }
  )
) or vector(0)

sum(
  max by (compute_host, resource) (
    cortex_vmware_host_capacity_usage{
      resource="cpu",
      availability_zone=~"$availability_zone",
      compute_host=~"$compute_host",
      # Remove enabled from decommissioned workload, since usually decommissioned hypervisors are disabled
      workload_type="hana",
      cpu_architecture="cascade-lake",
      decommissioned="true",
      external_customer="false",
      pinned_projects="false"
    }
  )
) or vector(0)

# Running disk workload
# Using max by compute_host and resource for deduplication if any other label changes
sum(
  max by (compute_host, resource) (
    cortex_vmware_host_capacity_usage{
      resource="disk",
      availability_zone=~"$availability_zone",
      compute_host=~"$compute_host",
      workload_type=~"$workload_type",
      cpu_architecture=~"$cpu_architecture",
      enabled=~"$enabled",
      decommissioned=~"$decommissioned",
      external_customer=~"$external_customer",
      pinned_projects=~"$pinned_projects",
      physical_host_size=~"$physical_host_size"
    }
  )
)

# Total max available disk if no workload
# Using max by compute_host and resource for deduplication if any other label changes
sum(
  max by (compute_host, resource) (
    cortex_vmware_host_capacity_total{
      resource="disk",
      availability_zone=~"$availability_zone",
      compute_host=~"$compute_host",

spec.text:
# Important 
Since Cortex can't map the unused commitments to reservations for vmware infrastructure (this is only supported for KVM landscape), we can't map this usage to individual hosts in this dashboard. **There are no commitments** shown in the following section. Also the following section **does not show decommissioned workload** separately. 

Keep this in mind when looking at the `available capacity`. Check the `Other Usages` section above.

You can also check out the VMware Overview Dashboard that is including these numbers.
